comparison.objective: Hold a spring-open cage door shut while sliding its bolt; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain door position against hinge force while translating a bolt versus maintain screw orientation against nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: Door shut and bolt thrown after both arms release versus target opening retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: The shared hold-while-lock pattern is generic; translational door latching and rotational adjustment locking are meaningfully different.
